description: The color scope of Dense data: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: color.roles
answers.why: Surface, text, action and status cover an operations tool.

answers.question: color.count
answers.why: One primary per view; the rest step back.

answers.question: color.definition
answers.why: One product, one brand ramp on cool neutrals.

answers.question: color.definition.steps
answers.why: The data is the hero. A strong ease keeps the selected-row tint almost white, so selection never colours the data. Hover and links sit clearly deeper than the button, so actions stand out.

answers.question: color.values
answers.why: Muted color keeps attention on the data.

answers.question: color.values.difference
answers.why: Status and categories in tables must differ at a glance, row after row.

answers.question: color.lands
answers.why: The brand primary marks actions and selection; status color marks late and failed records.

usage.why: A light tint shows selection without hiding the data.
Red always means fix this, and the icon says it without color.
Links and buttons look different, so people know which one navigates.

usage.use: Badge with a subtle fill, an icon and a word
usage.why: Subtle fills let many statuses share one table.
One primary makes the committing action obvious.
A ghost button has no edge, so next to a filled primary it reads as plain text and cancel gets lost. Secondary keeps a visible border, so people find it at once.

usage.use: Button secondary, then confirm in a dialog with Button danger
usage.not: Button primary as the first step
usage.why: Deleting is rare and costly; a confirm step catches mistakes.

neutral.$description: The neutral scale: the scheme's gray, step by step. Surfaces, borders and text read it, never a gray directly.

raised.$description: Parts that rise inside the page, such as raised cards.

floating.$description: Menus, popovers, dialogs, sheets and toasts: the layers that float above the page.

highlight.$description: The item the pointer or the keyboard is on.

pressed.$description: The item while it is pressed.

scrim.$description: Dims the page behind a dialog.

on-light.$description: Text on any light fill, in either mode.

on-dark.$description: Text on any dark fill, in either mode.

info-on-light.$description: Info text on a light info fill, such as its tint in light mode.

info-on-dark.$description: Info text on a dark info fill, such as its tint in dark mode.

success-on-light.$description: Success text on a light success fill, such as its tint in light mode.

success-on-dark.$description: Success text on a dark success fill, such as its tint in dark mode.

warning-on-light.$description: Warning text on a light warning fill, such as its tint in light mode.

warning-on-dark.$description: Warning text on a dark warning fill, such as its tint in dark mode.

danger-on-light.$description: Danger text on a light danger fill, such as its tint in light mode.

danger-on-dark.$description: Danger text on a dark danger fill, such as its tint in dark mode.

raised.$description: The 1px edge of a raised or floating layer: menus, dialogs and toasts, and raised cards.

selected.$description: The edge that marks a selected item, so selection is never color alone.

@.$description: The fill of a destructive commit: the confirm of a delete.
Info text and icons: neutral news, no action needed.
Category 1: chart series, tag dots and icons. Tag text uses color.text.primary.
Category 2: chart series, tag dots and icons. Tag text uses color.text.primary.
Category 3: chart series, tag dots and icons. Tag text uses color.text.primary.
Category 4: chart series, tag dots and icons. Tag text uses color.text.primary.
Category 5: chart series, tag dots and icons. Tag text uses color.text.primary.

category.$description: Colors with no meaning, for content that needs telling apart: decorative accents and non-semantic blocks such as tags, labels and chart series.

disabled.$description: The shared look of controls that cannot be used right now.

text.$description: Text and icons of a disabled control.

color.action.danger.headline: This one cannot be undone.
color.action.danger.line: Red only on the step that deletes a record.

color.action.danger.hover.headline: Still the delete.
color.action.danger.hover.line: The fill darkens under the pointer, so the risk stays in view.

color.action.primary.headline: The next step.
color.action.primary.line: One fill marks the action among many rows.

color.action.primary.hover.headline: Ready to act.
color.action.primary.hover.line: The fill darkens, so the analyst knows it will respond.

color.action.secondary.headline: Another action.
color.action.secondary.line: Export and filter stay plain beside the main action.

color.action.secondary.hover.headline: Still optional.
color.action.secondary.hover.line: A soft change under the pointer, quieter than the main action.

color.border.default.headline: Row lines.

color.border.raised.headline: The edge of a layer.

color.border.selected.headline: This record.

color.border.strong.headline: Type here.
color.border.strong.line: Inputs show their edge in a crowded screen.

color.category.1.headline: The first signal.

color.category.2.headline: The second signal.

color.category.2.subtle.headline: The second tag fill.
color.category.2.subtle.line: A soft ground for the tag; its words stay main text.

color.category.3.headline: The third signal.
color.category.3.line: Told apart from the others in a busy chart.

color.category.3.subtle.headline: The third tag fill.

color.category.4.headline: The fourth signal.
color.category.4.line: Told apart from the others in a busy chart.

color.category.4.subtle.headline: The fourth tag fill.

color.category.5.headline: The fifth signal.

color.disabled.border.headline: Not now.

color.disabled.surface.headline: Not available.

color.disabled.text.headline: Off for now.
color.disabled.text.line: Faded words, still readable, on a control that does nothing yet.

color.status.danger.headline: Breach.
color.status.danger.line: Analysts see the worst rows first in a long table.

color.status.danger.subtle.headline: Breach, in a badge.
color.status.danger.subtle.line: The fill marks the row without turning the table red.

color.status.info.subtle.headline: Under watch, in a badge.

color.status.success.headline: Resolved.

color.status.success.subtle.headline: Resolved, in a badge.

color.status.warning.headline: Escalated.
